title: Service Locator
description:
Building a sustainable tomorrow

KierBAM are a Joint Venture (JV) partnership between Kier and BAM UK & Ireland - BAM UK & Ireland's infrastructure segment is currently delivering the redevelopment project at a Royal Navy site located in Plymouth and we are seeking an experienced Service Locator.


The Service Locator will carry out the physical check and survey of all of the underground services within the area that is being investigated, the Service Locator will have the following responsibilities. You will use various geophysical techniques to locate the service, once they have been found, the services will be marked/spray painted onto the ground in the appropriate colour, defining the type and depth of the service. You will also maintain the contents of the permits on site, making sure the workforce remains compliant with conditions and processes outlined within the permits.

Due to the site being a high-security military naval base, additional security checks will be required a BPSS level of security clearance is necessary. These checks can take up to 8 weeks to process. Only candidates holding EU, NATO, 5 Eyes, or MISWG member passports and who have been UK residents for the last 5 years can be considered for this role.

Your team
  • Location: Devonport Dockyard, Plymouth
  • Contract: Permanent, 42.5 hours a week
Making Possible

In this role as Service Locator, you will be working in a live MOD facility. Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Authorise Permit to Break Surface
  • Ensure compliance with and enforcement of the project permit for the Break Ground procedure
  • Review method statements tailored to specific tasks
  • Mark all services within the work boundaries to protect colour standards
  • Provide teams with an overview of the services within their designated work boundaries and discuss methods for working around those affected services.
  • Implement an 8-point checklist during work gang briefings
  • Enforce any designated exclusion zones surrounding affected services
  • Obtain the required signatures for permit approval from the works team and the Project Engineer
  • Notify the BOSC of any discrepancies in the records
  • Investigate uncharted services as directed by the BOSC
  • Inform the BOSC of any services that have been removed from the work area, ensuring the service drawings are updated accordingly
  • Attach the most current SMD CAD drawing to the permit-to-dig
  • Ensure that no work gang operates under an expired permit for breaking ground or in an area lacking a permit.
  • Maintain service markings for the duration of the permit as well as incremental scans as excavations progress
  • This profile is not exhaustive. From time to time, you may be required by the Company to perform other tasks, which are not included in the above description, but are within your capabilities and, where necessary, training, and full support will be given
What do you bring to the role?

Essential:

  • We are seeking a candidate who can handle multiple tasks, show flexibility, and become a key contributor to our team
  • A CSCS Card is required (this must be obtained before commencing work)
  • Familiarity with Electromagnetic location and ground penetrating radar is essential
  • A solid understanding of industry practices and standards related to utility detection, including PAS 128 and TSA, is important
  • Candidates should have a proficient working knowledge of surveying equipment, such as GPR, CAT, and Genny utility detection tools
  • The ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team and interact with clients on-site is required
  • Knowledge of HSG-47 and GS-6

Desirable

  • Experience in the Nuclear environment would be considered beneficial
  • QCF Level 3 or Level 5 certification in utility mapping is preferred
  • Applicants should possess a minimum of 2-3 years of utility surveying experience
Whats in it for you?
  • Competitive salary
  • A wide range of family-friendly policies
  • Company car/car allowance/travel allowance
  • 8 % matched pension contributions
  • Private healthcare
  • Life assurance
  • 26 days holiday
  • 2 wellbeing days
  • 1 volunteering day
  • Personal and professional development
About BAM

Building a sustainable tomorrow. Thats our mission and our promise at BAM. Its how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe.

We strive to create an environment where everybody feels welcome and valued. Were on an exciting journey to employ the best talent to join us regardless of social background, race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability or other characteristics.

description:
Description

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is the senior operational leader of U.S. Hunger, responsible for translating enterprise strategy into daily execution. This role owns P&L performance across all business lines â Full Cart, Hunger Projects, and the Data/Intelligence engine â ensuring the organization's earned-income model (97%+ of total revenue) operates with precision, accountability, and scalability.

The COO must bring the instincts of an entrepreneur and the discipline of a corporate operator: connecting dots others miss, asking tough questions that drive clarity, and building the systems that allow talented leaders to perform at their highest level. Operational excellence and mission-aligned impact are not in tension here â they are the same thing.

Enterprise Operations & P&L Execution

  • Own P&L execution across all business lines â each engine must meet its margin, revenue, and impact targets.
  • Establish and drive the operating cadence â monthly reviews, quarterly business performance reporting, and clear accountability across departments.
  • Make resource allocation decisions across competing priorities â deploying people, capital, and attention against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Present operational performance, capacity, and growth execution to the Board of Directors.
  • Partner with the CEO on scenario planning, structural growth strategies, and enterprise-wide decision-making.

Program Leadership â Full Cart & Hunger Projects

  • Provide executive oversight of Full Cart and Hunger Projects â ensuring delivery excellence, measurable outcomes, and scalability.
  • Partner with program directors to evaluate, evolve, and scale programs in response to partner needs, market opportunities, and operational realities.
  • Drive integration between program design, data infrastructure, and client-facing delivery â ensuring mission impact and revenue execution are operationally connected.
  • Oversee supply chain and logistics operations to ensure consistent, high-quality program delivery at scale.

Revenue Growth & Partner Execution

  • Own enterprise revenue execution across health plan partnerships, corporate engagement, and strategic growth opportunities â ensuring acquisition and retention targets are consistently met.
  • Drive strategies that deepen existing partner relationships and expand engagement across multiple service lines, maximizing long-term value and organizational sustainability.
  • Represent U.S. Hunger externally with payors, partners, and stakeholders â translating operational insight into compelling value propositions that differentiate USH in the market.
  • Leverage buyer-side CSR experience and existing relationships across the corporate social impact and food access ecosystem to accelerate partner acquisition and deepen engagement.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the Chief Technology Officer to define business requirements, program design priorities, and operational needs that shape the technology and data roadmap â ensuring platform delivery enables execution across all business lines.
  • Manage the VP of Finance & Enterprise KPIs and VP of People & Culture â two executives who maintain direct visibility to the CEO through their seat at the executive table â ensuring fiscal discipline, enterprise analytics, and workforce strategy are aligned with operational goals.
  • Actively contribute to organizational governance, strategy, and enterprise-wide decision-making as the CEO's primary operational counterpart.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operational leadership team â setting clear expectations, driving accountability, and coaching leaders who are growing into executive-level roles.
  • Develop performance metrics and accountability systems that connect individual and team outcomes to enterprise financial and impact objectives.
  • Promote a culture of rigorous inquiry, collaboration, and continuous improvement â where leaders are expected to think critically, challenge assumptions, and own their outcomes.
  • Foster an environment where staff understand both the business drivers of USH's earned-income model and the transformative impact of their work on the communities served.

These essential job functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other duties as required.

  • Proven ability to lead and develop directors and VPs â coaching strong operators into executive-level leaders while holding them accountable to outcomes.
  • Demonstrated pattern of connecting dots across functions â seeing how operational, financial, people, and program decisions impact each other.
  • Experience at the board level â presenting performance, defending strategy, and engaging C-suite stakeholders directly.
  • Experience in mission-driven, earned-income environments where market discipline and social impact must coexist.
  • Strong communication across corporate, nonprofit, healthcare, and community sectors â direct, polished, and confident.

Essential Physical Skills

About Pacific Health Group

At Pacific Health Group, we care deeply about the people and communities we serve. We meet individuals with kindness, respect, and understandingâlistening first, honoring each person's journey, and offering support without judgment.

Through compassionate, person-centered healthcare, behavioral health services, and social supports, we walk alongside people as they work toward healing, stability, and a healthier, more hopeful life.

Our Core Values

Role Overview & Impact

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. Benefits & Employee Support

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)

Benefits

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits

Financial & Professional

  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

Pacific Health Group uses AI tools to assist with resume matching based on qualifications, skills, and location. All qualified applications are reviewed by our recruiting and HR team to ensure fair, equitable, and human-centered hiring decisions.

title: Product Engineer
description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

  • You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.


How To Apply

We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.

Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.

When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.


Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane

  • Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.

  • Meaningful equity and real ownership.

  • Small team, fast feedback loops.

  • Remote role that lets you focus and create.

description:
Who Connecteam is:

Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesnât happen behind a desk, and doesnât have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that donât talk to each other.

Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.

Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.

About The Role

The Onboarding Manager guides new customers who come from a partnership, through the implementation of Connecteam, from initial handoff and kickoff through a successful payroll launch. This is a customer-facing, hands-on implementation role combining project management, system configuration, payroll-process understanding, customer training and cross-functional coordination.

The Onboarding Manager works closely with customers, in collaboration with the partnerâs Implementation Managers and internal Connecteam teams to ensure employee data, time tracking, PTO, payroll rules and payroll system integrations are configured and validated correctly. The primary goal is to deliver a smooth onboarding experience while ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.

Implementations are payroll-first and planned around the customerâs first clock-in date, payroll schedule and go-live timeline. Depending on account size and complexity, the Onboarding Manager may continue supporting the customer through the first one to three payroll cycles.

Success in this role requires more than technical knowledge. The Onboarding Manager must be highly perceptive, able to read people and situations quickly, and skilled at navigating complex interpersonal dynamics while maintaining trust across multiple internal and external teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the customer onboarding process
    • Manage a book of business of customers that came from the partnership, from internal handoff through go-live and initial payroll stabilization.
    • Build implementation plans around first clock-in, payroll periods, training requirements and payroll-processing deadlines.
    • Lead kickoff, setup, training and clientâs payroll.
    • Maintain clear timelines, responsibilities, next steps, risks and customer communication throughout each project.
  • Lead discovery and solution design
    • Understand the customerâs workflows.
    • Translate business requirements into a practical Connecteam setup.
    • Identify complex requirements and suit the right solution with the design of the relevant setup.
  • Configure integrations
    • Configure relevant Connecteam account settings
    • Set up and manage the integration.
  • Deliver training and manage stakeholders
    • Train clients on Connecteam platform and integration process.
    • Train managers on time tracking and payroll workflows using Connecteam.
    • Adapt the training plan to customer size, structure and complexity while keeping sessions practical and process-focused.
    • Work closely with the assigned partner Implementation Manager.
    • Coordinate clearly across customers, partner, Sales, Support, Product, Integrations and leadership.
  • Troubleshoot, escalate and document
    • Investigate issues across the full workflow.
    • Determine issue owner and route it appropriately
    • Escalate payroll-impacting risks with clear documentation
    • Maintain accurate account records, architecture decisions, risks, next steps and handoff documentation.
Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, customer facing SaaS role with SMB & Mid Market client sizes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn software, troubleshoot issues, and understand integrations and data flows.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer-first approach when managing complex implementations.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with customers, internal teams, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and changing customer needs.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with payroll, HRIS, workforce management, scheduling, time & attendance, or employee management platforms.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, PEO environments, or multi-location/multi-entity organizations.
  • Experience working in a partner-led or channel-based customer environment.

Benefits:

    • Medical, dental, & vision coverage
    • Paid time off for vacation, sick days
    • 401k
Salary: $90K

We are accepting applications from employees working in the following states: Texas, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina, North Carolina, Colorado, Florida, Utah, and Georgia.

Joining Connecteam Is The Smart Move:

  • We build our people up. Every team member is treated as a long-term investment and we recognize the value in always nurturing and training them so they can go above and beyond in their skills and job duties.
  • We make an impact on our customerâs business. We are on a mission to provide managers of all business types and sizes with the tools they need to communicate, operate, engage, and run their deskless workforce. Our product offers them an effective and affordable solution to run their business.
  • We get the job done. Connecteam employees are passionate in executing their job duties so they can drive the company forward and provide real value to our customers.
  • We have fun! From weekly happy hours to holiday parties, we always enjoy each otherâs company (and good food, of course). Connecteam is like one big, happy family!
  • Everyone is welcome. Connecteam is committed to building an encouraging, caring, and supportive environment. We share a responsibility to support our team and enrich their lives.

Together we will shape the future of work!

description:
Field Maintenance Technician â CTC-LIS

Location: Townsville, Queensland

Employment Type: Full time


About Cubic Defence

At Cubic Defence Australia, we deliver world-class training and simulation capability in support of the Australian Defence Force. Our teams help create and sustain technology solutions that support mission success, safety and readiness for those who serve.


About the Role

Reporting to the 2IC Field Services, the Field Maintenance Technician is responsible for supporting maintenance activities and ensuring the ongoing availability of Combat Training Centre â Live Instrumentation System (CTC-LIS) equipment. This hands-on role supports the preparation, deployment and maintenance of CTC-LIS Relay Stations, including diagnosis and repair of telecommunications equipment such as UHF, microwave and LTE systems, as well as basic servicing and maintenance of diesel-powered generators.


This position requires significant time deployed away from Townsville to various Australian Army and non-Defence training areas. During Force-on-Force exercise phases, you will work in a small team environment providing 24-hour maintenance coverage in the field.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct inspections, maintenance and associated repairs of CTC-LIS instrumentation and telemetry equipment.
  • Diagnose and repair telecommunications equipment, including UHF, microwave and LTE systems.
  • Conduct pre-deployment readiness checks of telemetry and mechanical equipment.
  • Maintain CTC-LIS equipment during field deployments.
  • Service and perform minor repairs to diesel-powered generators.
  • Provide technical advice and assistance during instrumentation function checking phases.
  • Be prepared to deputise for the 2IC Field Services during periods of absence.
  • Assume a leadership role within a small team environment during field deployments when required.


About You

You are a capable and motivated technician with strong fault-finding skills, sound communication ability and the confidence to work in both field and workshop environments. You are comfortable operating in dynamic conditions, prioritising maintenance issues and clearly communicating intent and outcomes.


Background and Experience

  • Experience in the installation and maintenance of communications systems.
  • Basic knowledge and understanding of electronics and electrical principles.
  • Proven fault-finding and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to identify, analyse and prioritise maintenance issues.
  • Ability to work effectively in both field and workshop environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using IT systems and programs.


Conditions of Employment

  • Certificate III in Telecommunications, Electrotechnology or a comparable qualification.
  • Clean Heavy Truck Licence to drive company equipment, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Vehicle Loading Crane high risk licence, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Work at Heights qualification, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Forklift licence, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Successful completion of a National Police Check.
  • Ability to obtain and hold an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency security clearance.


Working Environment

This role requires significant time deployed in the field and flexibility to support business operations across multiple time zones. From time to time, you may be required to monitor and respond to telephone calls, emails and other necessary communications from Cubic, customers or suppliers outside ordinary working hours to support critical issues or business needs.


Compliance and General Duties

  • Comply with the role job description and Cubicâs Quality Management System.
  • Follow Cubic Health, Safety and Environment policies and procedures.
  • Comply with established security policies and procedures.
  • Follow Cubic Human Resources procedures.
  • Perform other duties as requested.


Apply Now

If you are a technically skilled professional who enjoys hands-on work, problem-solving in demanding environments and supporting high-tempo military training exercises, we would welcome your application.


The description above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements.

description:
Be part of a world-class team supporting vital Antarctic research and operations. The AIR Alliance brings together skilled professionals from Bouygues Construction Australia, The Australian Antarctic Division, Stantec and Mott MacDonald to deliver essential services in one of the most challenging and awe-inspiring environments on Earth. About The Role

The Quality Graduate supports the Alliance's quality management initiatives through quality assurance activities, compliance monitoring, audits, investigations, reporting, and continuous improvement projects. Working closely with stakeholders across the organisation, the role contributes to maintaining compliance with regulatory, contractual, and organisational requirements while supporting the effective operation of the Quality Management System. The Quality Graduate will assist the Quality Manager and Project Controls Manager with data analysis, auditing, risk management, and process improvement, while contributing to a culture of excellence and continuous improvement across the Alliance.

title: TBM Technician
description:
At Bouygues Construction Australia, we are dedicated to the design, construction, and delivery of nation shaping projects across civil infrastructure, engineering, and energy and services.

We have proudly been working in Australia for more than 25 years.

Our local experience in underpinned by significant global expertise and resourcing.

About The Role

As a TBM Technician, you will be responsible for providing civil engineering support and operating the EPB Tunnel Boring Machine on the River Torrens to Darlington (T2D) project on this key civil engineering project.

The T2D project involves the construction of a 10.5-kilometre motorway, with three lanes in each direction and including tunnel sections, linking the River Torrens area in the north to Darlington in the south of Adelaide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyse TBM parameters (face pressure, torque, thrust, spoil removal, etc.) to support civil engineers and ensure adherence to project timelines and compliance to safety standards and technical requirements. Â­
  • Coordinate with civil engineers, segment erectors, and conveyor personnel to maintain continuous operations according to production schedules and timelines, as well as applying appropriate procedures and selecting correct equipment.Â­
  • Continuously observing and analysing live data and adjusting parameters such as face pressure, torque, thrust, and spoil removal to ensure efficient and safe tunnelling. Â­
  • Diagnose and report technical issues to senior civil engineering staff. Â­
  • Ensuring the completed work satisfies the civil infrastructure projectsâ specifications, regulations and contract provisions. Â­
  • Organising and coordinating maintenance and repair work of the TBM equipment. Â­
  • Follow all safety regulations and environmental controls. Â­
  • Maintain accurate shift logs, tabulations and reports to assist with production planning.Â­
  • Participate in daily toolbox talks and safety briefings.
  • Ensure proper handover between shifts

Qualification & Experience

  • Relevant trade qualification or diploma. Â­
  • Significant demonstrated experience in the operation of Tunnel Boring Machines
  • 5+ years in TBM Operation
  • Strong understanding of TBM operational systems including hydraulics, electrics, and PLC interfaces
  • Ability to read and interpret tunnelling data, instrumentation, and geological reports
  • Must be safety-conscious and able to work in a team
  • Flexibility to work in shifts and rotational schedules
  • Valid certifications for confined space, working at heights, and first aid are a plus
  • Quantitative and qualitative risk assessment and monitoring of risk controls and actions involved in delivery and implementation of projects
  • Advanced skills in relevant computer software packages; Microsoft Suite; Primavera 6 etc
  • Written, verbal and presentation skills e.g. facilitating meetings, pre-starts and tool box meetings and basic cost control skills

title: Executive Operations & Project Manager
description:
Executive Operations & Project Manager

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Hours: Approximately 10 Hours per Week to Start

Compensation: $25â35/hour (Based on Experience)



About Viva Wellness Drip

Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

Position Overview

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:


Executive Operations

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
  • Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
  • Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
  • Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
  • Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule.


Business Operations

  • Organize company files, documents, and internal systems.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.


Preferred

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
  • Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.


You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.


Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.


Compensation & Growth

This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.


The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.


Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.


Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?

At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.


Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.

  • If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter, your work has a meaningful impact, and your career can grow alongside an innovative company, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Nanny Camp Hill
description:
Full-time Nanny, Camp Hill (40-hours), Commence ASAP!

Hours: MondayâFriday, approx. 40hrs per week (6amâ2pm) | Permanent Full-Time (4-day week may be considered for the right candidate)

Salary: From $70,000 + super + entitlements

Minis: Two boys, 4 & 2, with a baby girl due in November

Commence: ASAP

About Our Clients

This warm and vibrant Camp Hill family are looking for an easy going and friendly Nanny to become a valued part of their home. Dad is a busy business owner, while Mum is a stay-at-home mum preparing to welcome their third mini later this year. They value integrity, accountability and kindness, and have created a positive, respectful home where open communication and mutual appreciation are at the heart of family life.

Their boys are active, curious and full of laughter, enjoying swimming lessons, music, park adventures and playing with monster trucks. The family embraces a healthy lifestyle with limited screen time and loves outdoor play and learning through everyday experiences.

Duties

  • Sole charge of the minis when required
  • Planning fun, engaging outings and activities
  • Taking the minis to swimming, music and other social activities
  • Preparing healthy meals for the minis
  • Light household duties including kitchen tidying, dishes, rubbish and general wipe-downs
  • Driving the minis to activities using the family vehicle
  • Supporting the smooth running of the household during busy mornings


The perfect fit

You're reliable, adaptable and personable, with a genuine passion for supporting young families. You are known to be a nanny who is respectful and not overbearing and follows family routine whilst being confident working independently while respecting the family's routines and parenting style.

All you need is minimum 3-yrs professional childcare and or nanny experience, a valid Blue Card, police check, first aid/CPR certification and a current driver's licence. Most importantly, you'll be someone who builds trust naturally, communicates openly and enjoys creating a calm, fun and nurturing environment where children can thrive.

What's in it for you?

  • Become a genuinely valued and trusted member of a warm family
  • A supportive, respectful workplace where you'll be appreciated
  • Long-term, permanent employment providing stability and consistency
  • A nanny car for your job
  • Competitive salary plus superannuation and full entitlements
  • Opportunity to build meaningful relationships with three wonderful children as the family grows


If you have always dreamed about becoming a professional nanny with a natural gift bonding with children, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply Now

Hit Apply, or send your updated resume and introduction outlining why you'd be the perfect fit to hello@miniconnections.com.au. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: Regional General Manager Airports
description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years Airports leadership experience required
  • Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
  • Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
  • Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
  • Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.
  • Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.
  • Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously.
  • Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time.
  • Project management skills considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset.
  • Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams.
  • IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial.

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:

  • A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
  • Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
  • Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs

Think weâre a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Weâre Canadaâs leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet'sâ¯Alcohol and Drug Policy.â¯

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply â even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isnât the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

About

For more information about everything WestJet, please visit westjet.com/aboutus.

If you wish to withdraw your application or request that your personal information be deleted, please contact us at talent@westjet.com.

title: Hardship & Insolvency Specialist
description:
Not your average lender. Not your average workplace.
  
At Jacaranda Finance, we do lending differently. We're an award-winning, Australian-owned digital consumer lender on a mission to help everyday Australians build a better financial future. Our mission is simple but powerful: To be the backup lender of choice for everyday Australians when their bank says no.
 
The Role:
  
We're looking for a Hardship & Insolvency Specialist who thrives on supporting customers through complex and sensitive situations. This person will take ownership of hardship cases, working closely with customers and third parties to deliver fair, sustainable outcomes while providing a supportive and empathetic experience.
 
What you'll be doing:
  • Manage sensitive customer interactions across phone, email, and other channels
  • Work with customers and representatives to create tailored, sustainable repayment plans
  • Provide empathetic support to customers experiencing financial hardship or insolvency
  • Liaise with third parties (e.g. financial counsellors, legal representatives) to support customer outcomes
  • Review and action daily reports, prioritising hardship and high-risk accounts
  • Proactively identify risks and solve problems before they escalate
  • Deliver clear, professional, and compassionate communication
  • Ensure all cases are managed in line with compliance, policy, and regulatory requirements
  • Contribute to process improvements and share insights from customer interactions
  • Participate in ongoing training, 1:1s, and continuous development 
You'll thrive here if you have:
    • A minimum of 2 years' experience in hardship, collections, or a similar role
    • Take ownership and show strong judgment in complex customer situations
    • Lead with empathy while balancing fair and responsible outcomes
    • Communicate clearly, confidently, and with care
    • Are resilient and composed when handling emotionally challenging conversations
    • Think critically and solve problems with practical, customer-focused solutions
    • Act with integrity and align with responsible lending practices
    • Want to be part of a team that supports each other and improves every day

title: Sales Development Representative Outbound
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. Weâre a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agreesâ our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About The Role

As a Sales Development Representative, your primary responsibility will be to secure meetings with top prospective companies and individuals. You'll work closely with one paired Account Executive to generate meetings from their target account list. We encourage account development through outbound prospecting, social selling, networking, attending conferences and field marketing events, and any sales activity that would contribute to expanding the Tremendous brand. You will be the first line of engagement with prospective customers and will have an impact on Tremendousâ revenue growth and future success.

What You'll Do

  • Work primarily to bring in new deals through Outbound prospecting.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing and Customer Success teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business.
  • Use Outreach, LinkedIn, your own network, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging.
  • Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What You'll Bring

  • 2-3 years of prior sales experience, ideally in a similar outbound or SDR role.

title: Maintenance Fitter
description:
Our client - a leading food manufacturer based in Bendigo, is looking for 2 experienced Maintenance Fitters to join their team.


2 different shifts as follows:

  1. Sunday to Friday starting at 11pm on Sunday and ending at 7.30am on Friday.
  2. A month of 7 on 7 off start time 6am to 6pm on, then rotates to night shift for a month, 6pm to 6am.

Salary

- Annualised $50-51 per hour paid bi-weekly, including penalties and loading

- Earn up to $150k with overtime

- Meal breaks paid

- Tools paid

- 5 weeks annual leave

Primary Responsibilities:

The primary responsibilities of the Maintenance Fitters include disassembling and assembling pumps, diagnosing and resolving issues with pneumatics and hydraulics, and servicing and overhauling gearboxes. Candidates should possess strong mechanical skills and ideally have a background in food manufacturing, FMCG. The ability to think ahead and outside the box is crucial due to the high-pressure environment of food processing. Machining skills would be advantageous. While welding skills are a plus, they are not essential. It is important for candidates to have experience with the disassembly, reassembly, and servicing of gearboxes, as well as diagnosing pneumatic and hydraulic systems. We are open to considering heavy vehicle or HD fitters, provided they have the core mechanical skills required.

Top Priorities in the First Six Months:

In the first six months, the priorities for the fitters will be mastering the disassembly and assembly of pumps, diagnosing and resolving issues with pneumatics and hydraulics, and effectively servicing and overhauling gearboxes. Success in these areas will be critical to minimizing downtime and maintaining production efficiency.

title: Machine (Meta) Learner
description:
At kausable, we build causal, reasoning-first models that learn from a handful of examples and adapt without retraining. We are looking for a research scientist to advance the foundations of that approach, with a particular focus on Prior-Data Fitted Networks, meta-learning and the priors that determine what our models can learn. This is a research role with real implementation responsibility. You will form hypotheses, build the systems needed to test them and turn strong results into reproducible research, open-source work and production-relevant capabilities.

Tasks

Our research revolves around synthetic world data, deep-learning models trained and validated against it, and capable embedders across domains and modalities. You will:

  • Shape and pursue research questions around PFNs, meta-learning, in-context learning, representation learning, causality, active learning and adaptive decision-making.
  • Design priors and synthetic task distributions that expose models to useful structure, uncertainty and failure modes.
  • Develop model architectures and training methods for temporal, goal-conditioned and dynamical settings.
  • Build rigorous evaluations, including strong baselines, ablations, calibration tests and out-of-distribution diagnostics.
  • Implement research ideas reliably in Python and PyTorch, and improve the data and experiment pipelines around them.
  • Contribute to top-tier publications, open-source releases and the wider research agenda at kausable.

Requirements

We are looking for research scientists with a strong background in one or more of:

  • Deep expertise in PFNs, meta-learning, Bayesian inference, Neural Processes, representation learning, causality, active learning or a closely related area.
  • A record of generating original research hypotheses and testing them with scientific rigor.
  • Strong experimental judgment: you can distinguish optimization failure, prior misspecification and distribution shift.
  • Reliable implementation skills in Python and PyTorch or JAX.
  • A PhD in machine learning, physics, statistics or a related field, or equivalent research experience.
  • The ability to work independently, explain difficult ideas clearly and change your mind when the evidence demands it.
  • We are primarily hiring at senior level. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience who can demonstrate comparable depth, judgment and ownership.

Recommended qualifications:

  • A PhD in ML, Physics, or equivalent — or an MSc with exceptional experience
  • A strong grasp of causality, meta-learning, PFNs, and active inference
  • The ability to work independently and think from first principles
  • Hands-on experience with modern ML tooling (Python, PyTorch) and research workflows
  • An outcome-oriented mindset

Nice to have:

  • Causal modeling, active learning or Bayesian optimization.
  • Reinforcement learning, control, time-series modeling or dynamical systems.
  • Synthetic-data generation, graph-based models or simulation environments.
  • Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR or comparable venues.
  • Meaningful open-source contributions.

Benefits

🚀 Where This Can Go

You will help define kausable's research agenda, not just execute it. As the team grows, there is room to lead a research direction, mentor incoming scientists, and shape how our published work and open-source contributions reach the wider community. And as kausable begins working with its first customers, the research you do here is increasingly likely to leave the lab and reach real-world deployment.

🫂 Our Culture

We are "Putting Science at the Core of AI" — with all its curiosity, daringness, and humanity. That means we:

  • are scientists at heart, with a builder's mindset,
  • are open to challenge, grounded in curiosity and respect,
  • welcome diverse perspectives and value thoughtful, open debate,
  • focus on outcomes and real-world impact,
  • foster an environment of support, inspiration, and freedom for everyone to do their best work.

🏆 Perks & Benefits

  • VSOP equity: a real stake in what we build.
  • 30 days of paid holiday per year.
  • Statutory social insurance.
  • Conference travel and role-relevant learning.
  • Flexible hybrid work, with roughly one in-person team meet-up per month.
  • A high-end laptop and access to the compute required to do serious research.

⚒️ Tools and Infrastructure

  • Python, PyTorch, and PyTorch Lightning
  • Weights & Biases and reproducible experiment workflows.

title: Content Marketer (f/m/x) - AI-First
description:
This is a hands-on role, requiring native-level German and working English proficiency.

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling super powers to develop concepts, and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up — let’s talk!


🎯 What you'll own

  • Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

  • Plan and produce content across formats ( website, blog, video, social) that performs in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and adjust based on what you’ve measured.

  • Use AI tools as your default production layer: drafting, repurposing, ideation, research, so you can ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

  • Produce German-first content (that’s also translated in English), and work closely with the wider GTM team on broader copy requirements like campaigns and sales decks.

  • Brand tone of voice, ensuring consistency and differentiation

🙋 Who you are

  • You've produced content professionally and have a portfolio or examples.

  • You have a journalistic mindset — able to interview subject matter experts to extract insights, hooks, and stories.

  • You're fluent in German, comfortable writing and speaking it professionally. You’re also comfortable collaborating, presenting, and working at a professional proficiency in English.

  • You’ve already restructured how you work around AI — whether that's tracking AI visibility with something like Profound or Peec AI, producing multilingual content with tools like ElevenLabs or HeyGen, or researching with Perplexity instead of defaulting to Google. (If your content workflow looks basically the same as it did two years ago, this probably isn’t for you.)

  • Bonus, not a requirement: you've worked with or around frontline, industrial, or blue-collar audiences and understand operator priorities.

🤩 What's different here

You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

🚀 Why doinstruct

  • 400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which gives you real stories to tell.

  • We're moving AI-first as a company and will actively help you get deeper into AI tooling, because that's the direction we're going.

  • You're joining a GTM org that's still forming its shape, so what you build sticks.

📈 What success looks like

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

6 months Content you've produced is showing up in AI answer engines for queries that matter to us, and you can point to the pipeline it's driving. You’ve established strong partnerships with stakeholders both internally and externally.

12 months There's a repeatable content engine that treats AI answer engines as a first-class channel alongside traditional search. Content is having a measurable impact on revenue.

____

At doinstruct, you can make full use of your skills and play an active role in the further development of our start-up. And yes, we attach great importance to a positive working atmosphere, maximum transparency, communication at eye level, and support every step of your personal and professional development.

Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply.

We embrace diversity and hire people based on their ability to perform a job. People of any race, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, or marital status are welcome at doinstruct.

title: Staff Data Scientist - Network
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

About the role

Relay's network runs on forecasts. Every shift released in sortation, every middle-mile van dispatched, every last-mile route planned, every expansion decision made - all downstream of models that predict how parcels move through our system. When those models are right, the network runs efficiently and cost per parcel drops. When they drift, the cost compounds across every stage of the operation. The Network squad builds and maintains the forecasting engine that powers all of it, and Demand Forecasting is its core: one forecast of what will be available to sort, at outcode granularity, from D0 out to D30.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you are the technical anchor for Demand Forecasting. You own the hardest and most ambiguous parts of the forecast, and you set the methodology and validation standards the rest of the area works to. That means owning the single integrated forecast of what volume the network will have to move, by area and out to thirty days, which the demand-management layer then turns into the operational plan the sort centres and transport teams run on. It means owning the model-driven end of that forecast, where the horizon runs past any live tracking data and expected parcels have to be generated from models rather than observed. It means owning the forecast of inbound international volume, one of the hardest prediction problems we have. And it means owning the models that predict each parcel's size and weight, which turn a parcel count into the physical volume that actually has to be sorted and loaded.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time building, not managing. You set the direction for how Demand Forecasting models, evaluates and ships its work, and you raise the technical bar across the area, but you do it as the most senior individual contributor in the room, on the tools. You'll work alongside a Senior Data Scientist who owns the domestic volume forecasts, an ML Engineer who keeps the models running reliably in production, and an Analyst who owns forecast accuracy and data quality. People leadership, strategy and cross-squad priorities sit with the Data Science Manager who leads the squad; you own the science.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 Data Engineers, Analysts, and Data Scientists, with specialists embedded into squads across the business. You will sit in the Network squad and report into the centralised data team. Demand Forecasting is growing, and as its Staff DS you will have the deciding voice on its technical direction and the modelling approaches it adopts.

What You'll Do

  • Own the integrated forecast end to end. Blend live tracking signals in the near term with model-generated parcels further out into a single view, by area, from today to thirty days ahead. This is the view the demand-management layer turns into the plan that Sortation, Middle Mile and Last Mile actually run on.

  • Build the hardest models in the area. The model-generated long-horizon forecast, the inbound-international volume forecast, and the parcel size and weight models that make the forecast a measure of physical volume rather than just a count. These are the ambiguous, high-leverage problems, and they are yours.

  • Set the methodology and validation standards for Demand Forecasting. Define how models are evaluated, how accuracy is measured at each horizon (a forecast made thirty days out shouldn't be held to the standard of one made two days out), and what "good" looks like across the area's models.

  • Raise the technical bar. Review approaches, make the model-choice and build-vs-buy calls, and mentor the Senior Data Scientist and Analyst alongside you, without taking on their line management.

  • Define the forecast's interfaces. Decide what Demand Forecasting hands to the demand-management layer, to Routing, and to the network-planning function: at what granularity, with what guarantees, and how error is attributed when a number turns out wrong.

  • Learn the operational processes your models serve, supported by the squad and the teams who use the forecasts, and identify where the current approach falls short.

  • Own production quality across the estate, working with the ML Engineer so that models are monitored, drift is caught early, and accuracy problems are traced to the right cause rather than re-tuned blindly.

  • Work with Finance, who extend the operational forecasts into longer-range financial projections, to keep the handoff between operational and financial models reliable.

  • Quantify the impact of model error on cost per parcel, and use it to decide where the area invests effort.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

You have been the technical anchor on a modelling team before. You've owned the hardest problems, set the standards others worked to, and been the person the team turned to when an approach needed a call. You did it hands-on, as a senior IC, not by moving into management, and that's the path you want to keep on.

You think in interconnected systems. A demand forecast isn't just a number; it drives how many shifts are opened, how many vans are dispatched and how routes are planned, and it feeds a downstream planning decision and the network's expansion models. You care about how your models connect to the models around them, and you design their interfaces deliberately.

A deep track record of building and delivering models from ambiguous starting points. You understand the problem, build something useful, validate it against real operations, and iterate. You evaluate models well beyond standard offline metrics, connecting outputs to downstream applications and business KPIs and measuring how improvements translate into operational impact.

Strong Python and SQL, and depth across the full modelling lifecycle - from data extraction and feature engineering through training, validation and production deployment. You've worked with time-series forecasting across classical statistical approaches, gradient boosting and deep learning, and you understand the trade-offs well enough to make and defend the choice for a given problem. You'll be supported by a dedicated ML Engineer, but you set the standard for how the area's models are built.

At least 8 years in a data science or quantitative modelling role, with clear examples of models you built that informed operational or commercial decisions, and of methodology or technical direction you set for a team. You know a model isn't done when it trains well; it's done when it's running, monitored, and trusted.

You communicate with non-technical stakeholders with authority. The squads that consume the forecasts need to trust them, and that trust comes from explaining what the models do, where they're reliable, and where they're not, without hiding behind the maths.

You're comfortable using AI tools - LLMs, code assistants, and similar - to accelerate your workflow, from exploratory analysis to code generation, and you're curious about where these tools can augment the modelling process itself.

This role suits someone who wants to see whether their models made a real difference to how the network operates. There is a direct feedback loop between your work and operational outcomes, and as the Staff DS you own the most consequential end of it.

Logistics or delivery network experience is a plus, but what matters more is the ability to learn a complex operational domain quickly and model it well.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success.

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • 25 days of holidays.

  • Enhanced parental leave.

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help customers understand how different groups of users behave over time: who converts, who comes back, who becomes more engaged, and who may be starting to drop away.

You will lead the product strategy for user segmentation and lifecycle analytics. The work sits between product analytics and marketing technology. You will help customers define meaningful audiences, compare their behavior, understand what drives conversion and retention, and use those insights within Contentsquare and third party tools and platforms.

You will work closely with Engineering and Product Design, along with data, identity, AI, and other product teams. Some of the experiences you lead will depend on shared data and analytics services, so the role requires both clear product judgment and the ability to work collaboratively across different domains.

  • User and retention analysis: Help customers move from aggregate trends to cohorts and individual users, compare behavior over time, and identify what contributes to conversion, engagement, and retention.

  • Partner with data, platform, identity, and other product teams when shared capabilities are needed.

In just four years, we have raised a total of $370 million and have built a world-class team of 220+ employees (including 49+ PhDs with more than 40,000 citations), both remotely from 18 different countries and with offices in Belgium, France, Switzerland, Italy, the UK, headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

Our unwavering commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer.

Are you up for the challenge?


Position Overview

You'll own Silicon Product Engineering and our Bristol validation lab end-to-end — from tapeout through NPI to volume production — and lead the teams that get us there. The NPI Engineering Manager and Lab Manager report to you; you report to the executive team and partner closely with Design, Sales, and our external manufacturing ecosystem.

This is a director-level leadership role. It needs someone with the technical depth to make sound ATE, NPI and OSAT calls and earn senior engineers' respect, plus the commercial judgement to own budgets, headcount, and the day-to-day running of two technical departments as we scale across concurrent chip programs.

Key responsibilities:

Product engineering & strategy

  • The product engineering roadmap across all silicon programs, from tapeout planning to high-volume manufacturing

  • ATE strategy and major NPI decisions: build-vs-buy, test-coverage trade-offs, OSAT selection

  • Tapeout-to-production timelines — surfacing risk early and coordinating resolution across design, validation, and partners

  • Product qualification strategy for datacentre and automotive markets

  • NPI governance: phase gates, cross-functional reviews, executive reporting

External partners

  • Strategic relationships with OSATs, ATE vendors, foundries, and test houses — selection, negotiation, production readiness

  • Test program transfer, ramp, and ongoing yield improvement with OSAT and foundry partners

Bristol lab

  • Evolving the validation lab into a scalable, well-run operation; owning its budget, standards, and safety

  • Through the Lab Manager, overseeing silicon bring-up, characterization, and production test development

  • Ensuring validation capability (power, JTAG/scan, signal integrity, thermal) keeps pace with the roadmap

Team

  • Building, leading, and mentoring a multidisciplinary team of test engineers, validation engineers, and lab technicians

  • Recruiting and retaining senior talent in a competitive market

  • Translating executive strategy into clear direction, and representing both functions to the exec team, board, and key customers

What we are looking for:
